claims.citation: New York Herald, 6 August 1866, p. 10, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Caledonia (Br), Ferrier, Glasgow, July 21, with
mdse and 246 passengers, to F Macdonald & Co. Had one
death. Experienced heavy westerly gales the entire passage.
July 25, lat 53 45, lon 28 33, signalized a Bremen bark show-
ing a white flag, with No 25 in the centre; 27th, ship Mar-
mion, bound W.
